summary: Add written exam practice and active checks to complement the chapter's existing MCQs and clear explanations.

improvements.why: All seven existing items are MCQs, so learners never produce the precise definition themselves.
improvements.what: Add a short Define item requiring electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged ions, and a short Explain item that distinguishes electron transfer from the bonding force; supply markable rubrics, explanations and distinct three-stage hints.

improvements.why: All seven existing items are MCQs; none requires a written description linking electron changes, ion charges, ratio and giant lattice.
improvements.what: Add structured Describe items for magnesium oxide and calcium fluoride. Require correct ions and charges, charge balance and electrostatic attraction throughout a giant ionic lattice; use separate scheme points and distinct three-stage hints.

improvements.why: The cards have self-explain prompts but no discover questions that elicit ideas before the explanation.
improvements.what: Add one discover question per card: first ask what holds already-formed opposite ions together; second ask how one $\ce{Ca^{2+}}$ can be balanced by $\ce{F-}$ ions. Keep every existing card field intact.
